name: Quotes that chase themselves
short: Quotes from your price list that chase themselves until the customer answers.
long: Quotes built from the business’s own price list with VAT and a deposit. Send one and watch it get opened; it chases at 9am on day two and day five until the customer answers, then stops the moment they accept and pay the deposit.
proves: Fewer quotes go cold while you are busy.
features: A quote builder from the business’s price list and templates
Sent, opened, chased and accepted, each with its time
The customer accepts and pays the deposit from their phone
Started from an enquiry in the inbox, with the details filled in
story: Most quotes are lost to silence, not to a cheaper price. This keeps a polite nudge going so the business does not have to.
